title: Audit Before You Distill: A Controlled Workflow for Reasoning Transfer into Compact Medical Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Teacher rationales can help a smaller model answer health professions questions, but they can also reinforce errors. We examined when they help and how this evidence can guide training using Brazilian Portuguese questions from medical and multiprofessional residency examinations. First, we measured how a teacher rationale changed the student's probability of selecting the correct answer and compared this effect with rationales drawn from other questions. The complete rationale increased this probability by 21~p.p. when the teacher was correct and decreased it by 14~p.p. when the teacher was wrong. By intervening on the reasoning content, we showed that shuffled rationales did not produce the same pattern. Guided by this result, we trained only with rationales attached to correct teacher answers and compared answer-only training, step-by-step distillation, and our proposed Distill-SFT method. translated_title: 蒸馏之前先审计：面向紧凑型医学语言模型推理迁移的受控工作流
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2610.16713v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：教师模型（Teacher）的推理依据（rationales）可以帮助较小的模型回答健康专业问题，但也可能强化错误。我们研究了它们何时有帮助，以及这种证据如何指导训练，实验使用来自巴西葡萄牙语的医学和多专业住院医师考试题目。首先，我们测量了教师推理依据如何改变学生模型选择正确答案的概率，并将这种效果与来自其他题目的推理依据进行比较。当教师答案正确时，完整推理依据将学生选对答案的概率提高了21个百分点；当教师答案错误时，则使其降低了14个百分点。通过对推理内容进行干预，我们证明打乱顺序的推理依据并不会产生相同的模式。在这一结果的指导下，我们仅使用附加在正确教师答案上的推理依据进行训练，并比较了仅答案训练、分步蒸馏以及我们提出的Distill-SFT方法。Distill-SFT显示出适度的优势（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出蒸馏前先审计教师推理依据的受控工作流：教师推理依据在答案正确时提升学生约21个百分点、在答案错误时降低约14个百分点，据此仅用正确答案所附推理依据训练的Distill-SFT方法能更可靠地将推理能力迁移到紧凑型医学语言模型。
en_tdlr: Audit teacher rationales before distillation: rationales raise the student's correct-answer probability by 21 p.p. when the teacher is right but drop it by 14 p.p. when wrong, so training only on rationales tied to correct teacher answers (Distill-SFT) enables more reliable reasoning transfer into compact medical language models.
